newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch Jews demand return of war savings - paper.
newsitem.headline: Dutch Jews demand return of war savings - paper.

text.p: Jewish interest group Federatief Joods Nederland is calling on the Dutch government to return savings to the heirs of Dutch Jews killed during World War Two, the Algemeen Dagblad newspaper reported on Saturday.
Representatives of Dutch-based Jewish organisations were not available for comment on Saturday due to the Jewish Sabbath.

The newspaper said the organisation was representing four heirs in claims against the Dutch state and the Postbank, a descendent of the Rijkspostspaarbank, and expected to bring many The paper said bank accounts had lapsed without heirs to the funds being satisfactorily traced.
